description: This PHP source file implements an email API using PHPMailer. It provides functions for sending emails, handling mailer configuration, and closing SMTP connections. The code manages email composition, supports attachments, CC, and configurable SMTP settings. It also loads external dependencies such as PHPMailer classes and other project API files.

classes.name: PHPMailer
classes.description: Class from PHPMailer library used for composing and sending emails

methods.name: email_send_wrapper
methods.description: Wrapper function for sending emails, which calls email_send with prepared options.

methods.name: email_send
methods.description: Core function that constructs and dispatches an email using PHPMailer, supports attachments, CC, and HTML formatting.

methods.name: email_smtp_close
methods.description: Closes SMTP connection if it was established.

methods.name: make_lf_crlf
methods.description: Converts line endings in strings from LF to CRLF format.

methods.name: email_append_domain
methods.description: Appends the configured email domain to a given email address if applicable.
